summary: Diff adds ban-state migration scaffolding and new admin/account hooks/UI, plus a client-side pre-check to block banned users from creating orders. However, key backend-side enforcement and admin-dashboard filtering changes are not evidenced in the provided backend diff excerpt, and the diff summary also indicates several unrelated frontend UI/page redesign changes not requested in the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Hide user profiles with zero orders from the Admin Accounts list (only show accounts after first order).
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend hook comments claim the backend filters accounts, but the provided backend/main.mo diff excerpt does not show any logic in getAdminDashboard (or equivalent) that filters userProfiles based on order count/ownership. Without visible implementation, this requirement cannot be confirmed.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend exposes admin-only methods to ban/unban a principal, persists ban state, and blocks banned users from creating new orders with a clear error.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend calls actor.banUser/unbanUser/isUserBanned, and a stable bannedUsers set/migration module is added, but the backend diff excerpt does not show the admin-only ban/unban methods, the isUserBanned query method, or any create-order guard that prevents order creation for banned principals. Therefore backend enforcement cannot be verified from the diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin panel continues to support existing order edits (status updates, tracking number updates, deletion) without regression, and surfaces English errors without breaking rendering.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff summary does not include the admin orders UI/hooks or backend order-mutation methods; only accounts/admin-access sections and create-order hook changes are shown. As a result, preserving and validating the existing order-edit capabilities and error handling cannot be confirmed from the provided diff evidence.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (mentions AdminPanelPage but content not shown)

hallucinated_features.description: Broad, unrelated frontend redesign/content changes across multiple non-admin pages/components (e.g., Landing page marketing copy removal, navigation updates, watermark removal, accessibility enhancements, theming/layout adjustments).
hallucinated_features.reason: These changes are described in the diff summary but are not requested by REQ-1..REQ-4, which are focused on admin access control, account visibility after first order, banning/unbanning, and ensuring admin edits work without regression.

hallucinated_features.description: Client-side ban-status check in order creation flow (pre-flight call to isUserBanned) before submitting an order.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-3 requires backend enforcement (block banned users from creating orders). Adding a frontend pre-check is extra behavior not explicitly requested (though it may be acceptable as defense-in-depth).
